correctness.rationale: The definitions use named edge colours and full two-colour cycles of a completely specified 16-vertex cubic graph. Complete least-unmatched-vertex perfect-matching enumeration yields 33 matchings and 120 ordered three-factor partitions, and complete enumeration of all bichromatic cycles creates 342 undirected moves. From all 120 roots BFS yields the complete component sizes, all distance profiles and exact diameters. A distinct direct edge-colouring recursion and incidence-based move generator confirms all of these results and the 5-cycle obstruction. A verified four-generator permutation subgroup of order 96 acts freely transitively on the large component, with six involutory neighbours. These finite claims are fully replayable by the two included standalone scripts; no extrapolation or numerical approximations are used.

value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor graph is a classical nonplanar bipartite cubic symmetric configuration and a natural boundary case for Tait-colouring interchange. Unlike merely enumerating another class number, this determines the full two-sector reachability geometry, an intrinsic alternative-cycle signature, sharply different bipartiteness, a homogeneous Cayley sector and all minimum move distances. These features directly inform local-move sampling and expose a structural boundary not provided by prior generic class-count results.
